phases.description: Foundation phase: All storage, gRPC, CLI commands, and API providers can be developed in parallel as they have no cross-epic dependencies.
Configuration phase: Authentication and enterprise configuration depend on storage layer and CLI foundation. These can be developed in parallel.
UI phase: Interactive TUI and mode detection depend on CLI foundation. These can be developed in parallel as they share common CLI dependencies.
Core task phase: Task management is the central feature that integrates CLI, storage, gRPC, UI, and authentication. Must be complete before automation features.
Automation phase: Yolo mode and JSON output build on task management and mode detection. These can be developed in parallel.
Enterprise phase: Security permissions and audit logging depend on task management and configuration. These can be developed in parallel.
Distribution phase: Packaging and distribution must wait for all functional features to be complete, including independence verification.
